# Wind Farm Maintenance Plan – 2018 Inspections (Top 6 Turbines)

Note: The farm is synthetic (an invented grouping of real photos); years 2017/2018 are part of that grouping. Compare counts, not photos. Ranking from list_turbines is used as-is, not re-ranked.

## 1. Priority Ranking (tool-provided)
1. T01 (score 9.25) – max verified severity 3; 8 defects; trend same (verified [3,3] in 2017 and [3,3] in 2018)
2. T02 (score 5.0) – max verified severity 3; 5 defects; trend worse (2017 verified [1] → 2018 verified [3])
3. T10 (score 4.25) – max verified severity 3; 6 defects; trend worse (2017 verified [] → 2018 verified [3])
4. T07 (score 4.0) – max verified severity 3; 4 defects; trend same (2017 verified [3,1] → 2018 verified [3,1,1])
5. T12 (score 4.0) – max verified severity 3; 4 defects; trend better (2017 verified [3,3,3] → 2018 verified [3,1])
6. T03 (score 0.25) – max verified severity 1; 3 defects; trend worse (2017 verified [] → 2018 verified [1,1])

Rule applied: Severity 4-5 → P1 repair, 3 → P2 repair, 2 → P3 monitor, 1 → no order. Only verdict=ok defects get work orders.

## 2. Repair Work Orders (verified only)
- WO-001 (P2 repair, T01-2018): T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d2 (severity 3 crack, ok), T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d7 (severity 3 crack, ok)
- WO-002 (P2 repair, T02-2018): T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d1 (severity 3 surface_damage, ok)
- WO-003 (P2 repair, T10-2018): T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d6 (severity 3 crack, ok)
- WO-004 (P2 repair, T07-2018): T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d1 (severity 3 surface_damage, ok)
- WO-005 (P2 repair, T12-2018): T12-2018/DJI_0270_04_02/d4 (severity 3 crack, ok)
- T03-2018: no repair – only verified severity 1 defects (T03-2018/DJI_0368_01_06/d1, T03-2018/DJI_0011_02_05/d2); severity 1 needs no order. Unverified T03-2018/DJI_0011_02_05/d1 sent to re-inspection.

No P1 or P3 orders: no verified severity 4-5 or 2 in this set.

## 3. Re-inspection Requests (verdict needs_review / reinspect)
- WO-006 (T01-2018): T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d4, T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d6, T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d1, T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d2, T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d3, T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d4
- WO-007 (T02-2018): T02-2018/DJI_0711_01_04/d1, T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d2, T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d5, T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d6
- WO-008 (T10-2018): T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d2, T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d3, T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d4, T10-2018/DJI_0682_06_05/d1, T10-2018/DJI_0682_06_05/d2
- WO-009 (T07-2018): T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d3
- WO-010 (T12-2018): T12-2018/DJI_0270_04_02/d1, T12-2018/DJI_0270_04_02/d2
- WO-011 (T03-2018): T03-2018/DJI_0011_02_05/d1

Low confidence means asking for better evidence, never guessing severity.

## 4. Limits
- Only tools used; no photos seen. No defect, severity or trend stated beyond tool returns.
- Only top 6 ranked turbines processed per instruction; T04–T11 not assessed for orders.
- Severity-1 verified defects left without orders per rule.
- All verdicts, agreements and rule-check failures as returned by get_inspection.
